title: Assessment
description: The output of evidence fusion: how bad this looks (risk_score) and how sure we are (confidence), held as two SEPARATE values. An Assessment is not a decision - it is the input the deterministic policy gate reasons over.

risk_score.description: How dangerous this transaction looks, 0-100. Independent of confidence. NEVER multiply these two together.

confidence.description: How sure the system is of its own assessment, 0-1. Low confidence reduces AI autonomy; it does not change risk.

factors.description: Short machine-readable reasons that drove the score. Shown to the analyst. A risk score with an empty factors array is a bug - see rule 4.

evidence_ids.description: Every Evidence object considered. The UI links these; the audit trail stores them.

identity_assurance.description: Customer identity-assurance level at assessment time. Weak assurance lowers confidence.

critical_evidence_present.description: True when any consumed Evidence is marked critical. The state machine may not propose a decision while critical evidence is unconsumed.

degraded.description: True when a component failed - retrieval down, model timeout, consent revoked. Per the fail-toward-oversight rule this must lower confidence and can never yield APPROVE.
